description: Claude, ChatGPT (Codex), Grok, Gemini and GitHub Copilot quota in your system tray — a rings popover or a dock panel, on-device and read-only.
notes: AI Usage Meter installs per-user (no admin rights needed) into %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\AI Usage Meter.
Launch it from the Start menu; the tray icon appears once it is running.
Set 'Launch at login' in the app's settings to start it automatically.
